name: PUC
recent: PUC Berhad 近期完成两项私募配售，合共发行约3.05亿股新股，并设立最高30%的员工持股计划（ESS），已于2026年11月23日生效。同期，Genting Berhad 及 Genting Plantations Berhad 等多家机构因配售摊薄而不再是公司大股东。并于9月签署变更契约。
notable: 完成两批私募配售，合共发行约3.05亿股新股，发行价为每股 RM0.045。
设立最高30%的员工持股计划（ESS），已于2026年11月23日生效。
并于2026年9月4日签署变更契约。
risks: 私募配售发行新股导致股本扩大，Genting Berhad、Genting Plantations Berhad 等原有大股东因摊薄而不再是大股东。
最新一季（2026年6月30日止）净亏损为 RM2,590,000，净亏损率18.1%。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收为 RM14,282,000，环比增长116.9%，但同比下跌30.8%；净亏损为 RM2,590,000，净亏损率18.1%，较上一季度的29.2%有所收窄，但净亏损同比扩大1188.2%。

recent_en: PUC Berhad recently completed two private placements issuing approximately 305 million new shares and established an employee share scheme (ESS) of up to 30%, which took effect on 23 November 2026. Meanwhile, several institutions including Genting Berhad and Genting Plantations Berhad ceased to be substantial shareholders due to placement dilution. The company also proposed to dispose of 100% equity interest in wholly-owned subsidiary PUC Capital Sdn. Bhd. and signed a deed of variation in September.
notable_en: Completed two tranches of private placement, issuing approximately 305 million new shares at RM0.045 per share.
Established an employee share scheme (ESS) of up to 30%, effective 23 November 2026.
Proposed disposal of 100% equity interest in wholly-owned subsidiary PUC Capital Sdn. Bhd., with a deed of variation signed on 4 September 2026.
risks_en: The private placements enlarged the share base, causing existing substantial shareholders such as Genting Berhad and Genting Plantations Berhad to cease being substantial shareholders due to dilution.
Latest quarter (ended 30 June 2026) recorded a net loss of RM2,590,000, with a net loss margin of 18.1%.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM14,282,000, up 116.9% QoQ but down 30.8% YoY; net loss was RM2,590,000 with a net loss margin of 18.1%, narrower than the previous quarter's 29.2%, while net loss widened 1188.2% YoY.
